The '''Living Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained only on the [[Farm Maps|wilderness map]] as a monster drop from [[Wilderness Golem]]s (0.01% chance) or [[Iridium Golem]]s (0.02% chance).<ref name="golemchance" /> It can also rarely be obtained from cutting [[weeds]] (0.001% chance).<ref name="weedchance" />
